description: Search for free and legal copies of a textbook on OpenStax, the Directory of Open Access Books (DOAB) and Open Library. Inputs: query (a book title, an ISBN or a course topic such as "organic chemistry") and an optional limit of 1 to 10 results from each source. Open Library results are marked free when there is a public domain copy to read online, and borrow when the book is a free loan. No account or key is needed. If one source is down the others still answer and the reply names the source that did not. Example prompt: "Is there a free legal copy of the Calculus textbook by Stewart, or something close to it?"

limit.description: How many results to return, 1 to 10. Defaults to 5.

query.description: A textbook title, an ISBN (10 or 13 digits, hyphens allowed) or a course topic.

name: find_free_textbook

isbn.description: The ISBN that was searched, when the query was an ISBN.

query.description: The search text that was used.

results.description: Free and borrowable books, OpenStax first, then DOAB, then Open Library.

access.description: "free" means a free copy you can keep or read online, "borrow" means a free loan, "none" means no free copy is known.

authors.description: Authors or editors, when the source lists them.

note.description: One sentence on what kind of copy this is.

source.description: Where the book was found: "OpenStax", "DOAB" or "Open Library".

url.description: Page where you can read or download the book.

year.description: Year of publication, when the source gives one.

sources_unavailable.description: Names of the sources that did not answer, so a short list can be told from a failed search.

title: Find a free textbook
